title: Numbered bars
description: Four bars, the first three carrying a declared measure `number` (17, 18, 19) and the fourth none — an excerpt whose bars keep their numbers from the full score. The number is drawn small at the bar's start, above the top line; bar 2 also carries a segno and bar 3 a tempo mark, so the number sits beside the segno and under the tempo (which scans the ink beneath it and rises). Only DECLARED numbers draw: an engraver's number-every-system is a presentation choice the document does not carry, and bar 4 shows the absence (core-measure-attributes-gaps.md, item 8).
